remarks: This bright, well-appointed first-floor studio at 1 Arch Street offers something most studios can't: two private decks a front entry porch and a spacious rear wood deck with a fenced, landscaped yard. Whether you're sipping your morning coffee outside or winding down in the evening, you have your own dedicated outdoor retreat. Inside, the open-plan layout is smartly designed with a defined sleeping area, an open living/work zone, and a separate full kitchen - giving you the feel of a one-bedroom without the price tag. Hardwood floors flow throughout the main living space, and a ceiling fan with light keeps things comfortable year-round alongside a wall-mounted mini-split A/C system for efficient climate control. The full kitchen features white cabinetry, subway tile backsplash, ample counter space, a full-size range, refrigerator, and a dedicated dining nook everything you need to cook and entertain. A second door off the kitchen opens directly to the rear deck, making outdoor dining effortless. The spa-inspired bathroom is a true standout featuring a frameless glass walk-in shower with large-format tile, a built-in shower niche, dual showerheads, and a stylish pedestal sink with modern vanity lighting. It's the kind of bathroom you don't expect to find in a studio. Unit Highlights: Two private porches/decks - front and rear Hardwood floors throughout Mini-split A/C + baseboard heat Updated full bath with walk-in glass shower Separate full kitchen with subway tile back
